Claire / Luca,

I appreciate the update and Claires proposed staged remit. To keep services uninterrupted and preserve the relationship, we will accept the staged plan with the following binding conditions:

4) Multinexus must provide VAT evidence for the Italy payment at time of the second tranche; failure to provide timely VAT documentation will not delay the obligation to pay but may delay reconciliation.

Were committed to working with you to avoid escalation, but we need payment certainty. Laura, please confirm the split invoice issuance timeline. Kim, please confirm MAP liability language is acceptable or flag any blocking terms.

Claire, Luca: if youd prefer a short CEO-to-CEO 15-minute call tomorrow to align, we can schedule — otherwise we expect wire confirmation for the first tranche and the signed MAP.

Regards,
